title: A Quick Note from the Omnivue Team 🛠️
message:
We owe you a quick update! You might have noticed some turbulence over the past week, particularly in the Kids Section. While we've been working hard behind the scenes to upgrade and expand Omnivue, maintaining active features alongside heavy system upgrades proved a bit tricky for our small team.

Things are back up, but you may still spot minor hiccups while we finish stabilizing everything. 

If you ever bump into a broken link or a section playing hide-and-seek, please let us know via the Help Center! Reaching out directly helps us spot and fix issues much faster. Thank you for your patience and for sticking with us as we build a bigger, better Omnivue!

title: New Sports Channels & Upgraded TV Experience
message: Live TV is better than ever! We've added premier sports channels—including Sky Sports News, Main Event, Premier League, and Football—delivering smooth, stutter-free streams so you never miss trending football action. Explore our sleek new layout with organized categories (Local, Entertainment, Sports), Watch History for quick channel switching, and a live TV EPG to track your favorite broadcasts.
